Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Rosa Esposito | DOB: 12/23/1970 | MRN: SYN-4919204
Date of service: 01/17/2025 | Dr. Noor Iverson, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
54-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2023, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hypertension, type 2 diabetes.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
She has taken weekly methotrexate (25 mg) for the better part of six months, yet the small joints of both hands remain swollen.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: active seropositive rheumatoid arthritis; clinical disease activity index sixteen today.
Latent TB blood test and hepatitis B panel drawn on 11/12/2024 both came back clear.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
